name: install-distribute-cwm-sol
description: Distributes images to a device. The input and output has been updated to follow the input and output schema. The output schema is given in metadata. Failure: If the device is a Cisco device then the EMS activity executor is called, otherwise NSO activity executor is called. If the EMS/NSO adapter return failure status then the workflow would return failure.

definition.name: install-distribute-cwm-sol

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 900 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") }

stateDataFilter.output: ${.activity.type="SetSWIMPreferences" | .swimPreferenceList += [{"key": "ImageTransferProtocolOrder", "value": (.distribute.swimPreference.imageTransferProtocolOrder | map(.protocol | ascii_upcase) | join(","))}, {"key": "copyByServer", "value": (if .distribute.swimPreference.copyByServer then "Y" else "N" end)}]}

logs.message: Calling emsactivityexecutor to do set SWIM preference

dataConditions.name: check-iosxr
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco 8000 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540L Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5700 Series Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 9000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco XRv 9000 Series Virtual Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 5500 Series") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Network Convergence System 540 Series Routers") }

dataConditions.name: check-iosxe
dataConditions.condition: ${ (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 920 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco ASR 1000 Series Aggregation Services Routers") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8000V Edge Chassis Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 8300 Series Edge Platforms") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") }

stateDataFilter.output: ${ .activity.type="distribute" | .activity.input."image-files"=."app-data".data.softwareImages | .activity.input.location=(if (.distribute.location and .distribute.location != "") then .distribute.location else "harddisk:" end) | .deviceIp=."app-data".device.ip | .emsResourceId="EMS" | (if(.distribute.vrfName != null and .distribute.vrfName != "") then .activity.input.vrf=.distribute.vrfName else . end) | .activity.input.fpd=(if .distribute.fpd == true then "true" else "false" end) | .activity.input.isISSUUpgrade=(if .distribute.isISSUUpgrade == true then "true" else "false" end)}

${ .activity.type="distribute" | .activity.input."image-files"=."app-data".data.softwareImages | .activity.input.location=(if (.distribute.location and .distribute.location != "") then .distribute.location else (if ((."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches")) then "flash:" else "bootflash:" end) end) | .deviceIp=."app-data".device.ip | .emsResourceId="EMS" | (if(.vrfName != null and .vrfName != "") then .activity.input.vrf=.vrfName else . end) | .activity.input.fpd=(if .distribute.fpd == true then "true" else "false" end) | .activity.input.isISSUUpgrade=(if .distribute.isISSUUpgrade == true then "true" else "false" end) }

${ .activity.type="distribute" | .activity.input.repository=."app-data".data.repository | .activity.input."image-files"=."app-data".data.softwareImages | .activity.input.location=(if (.distribute.location and .distribute.location != "") then .distribute.location else (if (."app-data".device.vendor | ascii_downcase == "cisco systems") then "harddisk:" else "/var/tmp" end) end) | .device=."app-data".device.name | .resourceId=."app-data".resource | (if(.distribute.vrfName != null and .distribute.vrfName != "") then .activity.input.vrf=.distribute.vrfName else . end) }

${ .activity.type="distribute" | .activity.input.repository=."app-data".data.repository | .activity.input."image-files"=."app-data".data.softwareImages | .activity.input.location=(if (.distribute.location and .distribute.location != "") then .distribute.location else (if ((."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9300 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 3650 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 Series Switches") or (."app-data".device.productSeries == "Cisco Catalyst 9500 series switches")) then "flash:" else "bootflash:" end) end) | .device=."app-data".device.name | .resourceId=."app-data".resource | (if(.distribute.vrfName != null and .distribute.vrfName != "") then .activity.input.vrf=.distribute.vrfName else . end) }

logs.message: Calling emsactivityexecutor to do distribute operation
Calling actionexecutor to do distribute operation

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "failed", "message": (if .activityOutput.jobDetails.message != null then .activityOutput.jobDetails.message else (if .activityOutput.message != null then .activityOutput.message else "Distribute failed" end) end)}}

${{"status": "failed", "message": "The input for set swim preference is not proper. Values for copyByServer must be boolean and ImageTransferProtocolOrder must be among these: [SCP, SFTP, FTP, TFTP, HTTP, TELNET, SSH]"}}

${{"status": "failed", "message":  (if .errors[0].error != null then "Error is: " + .errors[0].error else (if .message != null then .message else "The set swim preferences operation failed." end) end)}}

logs.message: Selected product series is not supported

stateDataFilter.output: ${{status:"failed", message: "Selected product series is not supported." }}

logs.message: Error while executing distribute activity on resource

stateDataFilter.output: ${{"status": "failed", "message": (if .activityOutput.jobDetails.message != null then .activityOutput.jobDetails.message else (if .activityOutput.message != null then .activityOutput.message else "Error while executing activity on resource." end) end)}}

definition.description: Distributes images to a device. The input and output has been updated to follow the input and output schema. The output schema is given in metadata. Failure: If the device is a Cisco device then the EMS activity executor is called, otherwise NSO activity executor is called. schema.title: Software Image Distribution Configuration

distribute.title: Distribution Settings

fpd.title: FPD Upgrade
fpd.description: Enable Field Programmable Device (FPD) upgrade during distribution

vrfName.title: VRF Name
vrfName.description: Virtual Routing and Forwarding (VRF) instance name for network isolation

location.title: Storage Location
location.description: Target storage location for distributing software images

isISSUUpgrade.title: ISSU Upgrade Mode
isISSUUpgrade.description: Enable In-Service Software Upgrade (ISSU) mode for zero-downtime distribution

swimPreference.title: SWIM Transfer Preferences

copyByServer.title: Copy By Server
copyByServer.description: Enable server-side copy operation for image transfer

imageTransferProtocolOrder.title: Protocol Order
imageTransferProtocolOrder.description: Ordered list of protocols to attempt for image transfer

swimPreference.description: Software Image Management (SWIM) transfer protocol preferences

distribute.description: Settings for software image distribution process

schema.description: Configuration for distributing software images to network devices
